title: TCMIIES: A Browser-Based LLM-Powered Intelligent Information Extraction System for Academic Literature
abstract: arXiv:2605.07507v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The rapid growth of academic publications has created a need for tools that extract structured knowledge from unstructured scientific texts. Although large language models (LLMs) can perform natural language understanding and information extraction, existing solutions often require specialized infrastructure, programming expertise, or fine-tuned domain-specific models, which limits their accessibility for researchers in specialized fields. This paper describes TCMIIES (Traditional Chinese Medicine Information Intelligent Extraction System), a browser-based, zero-installation platform that uses commercial LLM APIs to perform structured information extraction from academic literature. The system employs a schema-guided prompting framework with automatic system prompt generation, allowing researchers to define custom extraction schemas through a graphical interface without programming. translated_abstract: 学术出版物数量的快速增长催生了对从非结构化科学文本中提取结构化知识的工具的需求。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）能够执行自然语言理解和信息提取任务，但现有解决方案通常需要专门的基础设施、编程专业知识或针对特定领域微调的模型，这限制了它们在专业领域研究人员中的可及性。本文描述了TCMIIES（中医药信息智能提取系统），这是一个基于浏览器、零安装的平台，利用商用LLM API对学术文献执行结构化信息提取。该系统采用基于模式引导的提示框架，并自动生成系统提示，使研究人员能够通过图形界面自定义提取模式，而无需编程。TCMIIES采用纯前端架构，该架构...
tldr: 本文提出TCMIIES，一个零安装的浏览器平台，通过商用大语言模型API和模式引导提示框架，让非编程研究人员能图形化定义提取模式，从学术文献中高效提取结构化信息。
en_tdlr: This paper presents TCMIIES, a zero-installation browser platform that leverages commercial LLM APIs and a schema-guided prompting framework, enabling non-programmer researchers to graphically define extraction schemas for efficient structured information extraction from academic literature.
